''See also: [[Voice of Solstice Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Voice of [[Solstice]], also known as The Voice, serves as a high-ranking representative for the organization known as [[Solstice]], which is comprised of [[World Spirits]]. This entity communicates through speakers and voice modulators to maintain a neutral tone, often appearing as an androgynous presence. Visually, the Voice typically manifests as a dark, humanoid silhouette or Shadow{{!}}shadow that is outlined by golden or reddish-gold light, resembling an eclipsed moon. While the entity's physical form is often a projection with skin as black as the void, it has been observed using a staff made of bone or wood topped with a hand holding a [[ring]] of fire, possibly retrieved from a subspace pocket. It is unclear if the Voice is a single individual or a rotating position held by different people. The entity possesses an extensive level of knowledge and claims that the organization's magic is superior to that of a King. The Voice interacts with various figures, including Varic Vallenar{{!}}Captain Vallenar, to coordinate efforts and manage the transfer of information in service of their cause.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Serving as a representative for the highest leadership in [[Solstice]], the Voice of [[Solstice]] is a summoned beast rather than a person. This entity appears as a humanoid Shadow{{!}}shadow or dark silhouette, often appearing like an eclipsed moon outlined by golden light. While possessing an androgynous voice, the creature's blank face can split open into a smile to release reddish light. During a [[ritual]], the twelve-foot-tall being takes the first position while wielding a staff topped by a grasping hand that holds a burning [[ring]] of fire. In this form, the creature wears a The mask{{!}}mask and features an orb of darkness for a head outlined in reddish-orange flame.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“I am a representative of the highest leadership in our organization. You can consider me the Voice of Solstice.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“And we don’t need him for this. Our magic is superior even to his.”<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c22" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“I will take the first position,” the Voice of Solstice said.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c38" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|“The Zenith Processor is our ally,” the Voice went on, “but he is not one of us.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c39" />}}
